decision_time_rule: M4 00:00Z timestamps are daily date markers, not availability instants. This lane freezes each cutoff at the SHFE day-session close, 15:00 Asia/Shanghai (07:00Z), so the completed daily signal bar may be visible without treating midnight as a completed session.

underlying_ohlcv_asof.basis: BarStore accepts an explicit UTC as_of and the lane disables continuous-contract synthesis and every fallback; actual per-series presence remains a coverage result.

delta_dte.basis: The bounded paired-trading input contract has no decision-time CN option delta series or exact exchange expiry calendar; percentage OTM and approximate expiry are prohibited proxies.

causal_iv.basis: No protocol-pinned, decision-time IV history with a declared causal warmup is available through the bounded current interfaces; Black-Scholes back-out and upstream metrics are prohibited proxies.

regime.basis: No frozen causal CN Feitian regime-label contract is present in paired-trading; upstream trend/range/stress labels are independent evidence and are not imported.

option_price_cadence.basis: The paired-trading OptionStore interface is daily-only and the frozen runtime store has no files; Feitian DD/tight-stop work requires option 15-minute or finer bars.

dd_line.basis: There is neither a frozen DD-line definition nor bounded option intraday inputs in paired-trading; a percent stop or generic swing line would be an unapproved proxy.

bid_ask.basis: Current bar schemas contain OHLCV/turnover/open-interest but no historical bid or ask fields; costs are not imputed.

prohibited: future rows at a decision timestamp
candidate promotion, M7, trading, or execution
next_gate: Provision the exact eight frozen underlying files (au0/ag0 x D/W/60min/15min) with provenance sufficient to cover all 16 requested decision-series snapshots through their decision timestamps; then rerun this verifier. Faithful Feitian evaluation remains separately blocked until a new protocol pins decision-time CN delta plus exact DTE, causal IV warmup/history, causal regime labels, option <=15min bars, a formal DD-line definition, and historical bid/ask.
